title: Integrality (II): the slice-integral current [[0,1]] × X is integer multiplicity (supplied step 8, B5)
statement: Assume, as hypotheses, (CB) the frozen type of Submission.cmcdt_lp_covector_norm_bounds ((L1) |A^#β| ≤ ‖A‖^k|β|, (L2) |ι_vβ| ≤ |v||β|, (L3) |α(τ)| ≤ |α| for orthonormal τ), and (VO), (MR), (IMC), (IMS) exactly as in the selected statement (the frozen types of dtc_vanish_off_support, cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure, cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub and cmcdt_im_series, as antecedents). Then conclusion (II) of the selected statement holds. Write ι(t, x) := (t, x_1, …, x_N) ∈ ℝ^{N+1} and e₀ := (1, 0, …, 0). Let N, k ∈ ℕ, X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N) integer multiplicity with compact support and M(X) < ∞, and C ∈ 𝒟_{k+2}(ℝ^{N+1}). Suppose that for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+2}(ℝ^{N+1}) there is η ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^N) with η(x)(v_1, …, v_{k+1}) = ∫_0^1 ω(ι(t, x))(e₀, ι(0, v_1), …, ι(0, v_{k+1})) dt for all x and v, and C(ω) = X(η). Then C is integer multiplicity.
